scope: Before paying typed module boundary enumeration, exact-project eliminable internal variables from each discovered module using only already sealed UNATE and 2CNF existential projection rules, then delegate the rewritten exact formula to the sealed cycle-cut/forest interaction compiler.
historical_inheritance: sealed open connected query-message UNATE projection

representation_invariant: Original source CNF is existentially equivalent to the conjunction of all projected module messages and all untouched unsupported module factors, with eliminated internal variables scoped locally to their original modules.
algorithm: build the parent APMA width<=3 typed mosaic and deterministic connected native modules
define each module boundary as variables shared with at least one other module; all remaining module variables are internal
if a module has internal variables and its complete module factor is UNATE, existentially project internal variables by the sealed UNATE rule
else if a module has internal variables and is 2CNF, existentially project them by sealed exact Davis-Putnam elimination
else keep that module factor unchanged
recompose projected messages plus untouched factors and verify exact source coverage by module provenance
delegate the rewritten source to the sealed canonical cycle-cut/forest compiler
for SAT, recover eliminated module-internal witnesses by conditioning each original native module on returned boundary values and calling its native polynomial solver

complexity_contract.2CNF_projection: polynomial; distinct width<=2 clauses bound the projected message polynomially
complexity_contract.parent_enumeration: only after parent forest/cycle-cut width certificates
